extraction.Name: Benjamin Beauvais
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded Sept. 29, 1924 by the Tri-County Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Benjamin and his wife conveyed the land by deed on September 5, 1924 to James S. Slaughter for $3,000.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739628 issued; southeast quarter of section 3, township 39, range 28; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 2, 1920; Benjamin had a wife at time of conveyance
